ticket_failed: Failed to obtain a connection ticket.
connection_error: Terminal connection error. The endpoint may be offline.
title: Live Interactive Terminal
input_placeholder: Type a command and press Enter...
hint: Interactive session streams bidirectionally over the agent's outbound WebSocket. Closing this window terminates the shell process on the endpoint.
mode_pty_hint: The shell runs on a pseudo-terminal: keystrokes, Ctrl+C, Tab completion and full-screen programs work as in PuTTY.
mode_line_hint: This agent is older and runs the shell without a terminal. Lines are sent on Enter; update the agent for a full terminal.
pty_hint: Ctrl+C interrupts the running command on the endpoint. Use Ctrl+Shift+C and Ctrl+Shift+V to copy and paste. Closing this window ends the shell.
